content: Mudlet official documentation states Mudlet scripting uses Lua 5.1 and exposes package/runtime APIs such as sendGMCP, event handlers, timers, UI output/link functions, package installation, and database helpers. For boop hardening, keep all package Lua 5.1-compatible, guard optional globals, avoid relying on newer Lua features, use documented Mudlet APIs directly, and treat Mudlet 4.20+ as a practical CI/runtime floor because installPackage success return behavior was fixed in 4.20.0 while current public Mudlet releases have moved beyond the CI pin.
